top_signals.title: Dollar (USD) Outlook: What Is the ‘Debasement Trade’ and Why Does It Matter?
top_signals.summary: Political and fiscal uncertainty in the US is prompting investors to again turn nervous toward the dollar. As some have offloaded the currency, alternative assets such as Bitcoin and gold have seen their value soar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Iran Unveils Huge New Gas Discovery Amid U.S. Economic Pressure
top_signals.summary: Iran has made a new gas discovery in the southern province of Fars, with the oil ministry reporting estimates of 7.5 trillion cubic feet of gas, of which 73% is recoverable, or 5.7 trillion cu ft. top_signals.title: Canadian Stocks Whipsaw After US Trade Talks Break Down
top_signals.summary: Canadian stocks flipped between gains and losses at Monday’s open after the collapse of talks with the US unleashed what threatens to become a widening trade war, with Prime Minister Mark Carney recalling his negotiators from Washington.

top_signals.title: Russia Scrambles to Restore Fuel Supplies as Refineries Resume Operations
top_signals.summary: Amid the ongoing fuel crisis in Russia, authorities are rushing to ease concerns that the shortages are worsening. Russia has been suffering from a gasoline and diesel crunch since the spring, when Ukraine intensified its drone attacks at Russian refineries, aiming to cripple fuel supply to the front lines and to the domestic Russian market.
